description: Perform a regulatory compliance audit for five chemicals: Chlorine, Acetone, Propane, Benzene, and Formaldehyde (Solution). Use CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) to determine if each chemical is listed under the following federal regulations: Clean Air Act 112(r) (Risk Management Program), Clean Water Act 311 (Hazardous Substances), and EPCRA Section 313 (Toxics Release Inventory). Create a CSV file at '~/Desktop/compliance_matrix.csv' with headers 'Chemical,CAA_112r,CWA_311,EPCRA_313'. Fill the matrix with 'YES' or 'NO' for each chemical/regulation combination based on the Regulatory Information section in CAMEO.
